data.name: Riddhima
data.gender_notes: Riddhima is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Riddhima is a Hindu name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Riddhi' which means wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. This name is believed to bring abundance, success, and good luck to the bearer. The name Riddhima carries the meaning “Goddess of Wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Riddhima usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Riddhima is a name of the Hindu goddess of wealth and prosperity, Lakshmi. It signifies the attainment of material and spiritual wealth and the blessings of the goddess.
data.etymology: Riddhima belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Wealth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Riddhima total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
